turns.content: Hey, I need a LinkedIn post about the Fujifilm X100VI. Here are some facts: it has a 23mm f/2 lens, a hybrid viewfinder, and 4K video capabilities. Can you help me craft something that highlights these features?

I created the draft and validated it against the confirmed product facts and requested constraints.

Introducing the Fujifilm X100VI! This compact camera features a 23mm f/2 lens, providing stunning image quality. Experience the versatility of the hybrid viewfinder, allowing you to switch between optical and electronic viewing. Plus, capture your moments in incredible detail with its 4K video capabilities. Explore the possibilities with the X100VI!
